sources.summary: Promotion: according to wallpaper specialist Selected Wallpapers, wallcoverings are increasingly equipped with woven, sound-absorbing and embossed qualities, which is changing "what a wall is asked to do". Selected Wallpapers explained that there is an increasing demand for tactile wallpapers, which now play a large part in how a space looks and feels.
